claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings provide three validated complementary modes (citation heritage recovery, section cross-lingual for facts/holdings, linear hybrid complement) at max available scale (22yr/144k), but do not and cannot replace TF-IDF citation hybrids as primary jurist-preference mode under current data constraints.
evidence_summary: All headline metrics recomputed from raw JSON outputs in /tmp/lex_team/legal_distance/results/174k_dense_embeddings/. Citation heritage AUC 0.79-0.85 > 0.75 threshold at 21-22yr scale (344/100 pos pairs). Section cross-lingual: Sachverhalt 0.282 > 0.2, Dispositiv 0.150 > 0.1, Erwaegungen 0.094 < 0.1 (honestly reported failure). Linear hybrids PASS adversarial gates at 19yr+ with JP 0.61-0.67 vs TF-IDF 0.78-0.79 (10-18pt deficit, honestly disclosed). True OOS JuristPref ceiling ~0.53 confirmed via v8 holdout. Dense FAILS jurist gate at all scales (JP 0.05-0.43). Boilerplate resistance negative all reps. Legal TF-IDF from bge_ corpus FAILS. Structural blockers verified: no bge_/bger_ mapping, missing 2022-2026 parquet, no section extraction at 174k. No leakage beyond acknowledged TF-IDF SVD issue (minimal per holdout). No benchmark gaming, p-hacking, or selective reporting detected. Valid negative/null work at evidence ceiling.
